extracted.intended_audience: readers, instructors, and students using Stein & Shakarchi's Real Analysis textbook
extracted.subtask_description: A list of corrections and clarifications (errata) for the Real Analysis textbook by Elias M. Stein & Rami Shakarchi, specifying textual, formulaic, and reference fixes by page and location.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boundary definition (p.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: The boundary of E is the set of points which are in the closure of E but not in its interior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace the existing/incorrect wording on page 3 with this precise definition of boundary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product formula (p.30)
rubrics_metrics.description: The formula for the product f g should read: f g = 1/4 [(f + g)^2 − (f − g)^2].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correct the algebraic identity displayed on page 30 to this form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completion of proof of Theorem 4.3 (p.32)
rubrics_metrics.description: To complete the proof of Theorem 4.3 in fact requires the argument given on the following page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A missing or incomplete argument on p.32 must be supplemented by the argument printed on the next page; readers should consult the following page to finish the proof.

rubrics_metrics.name: Square of difference (p.166)
rubrics_metrics.description: In the middle of the page, the quantity SN(f) − SM(f) should be replaced by (SN(f) − SM(f))^2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace the indicated linear difference by its square at the specified location on p.166 (fixes a likely algebraic/typographical error).

rubrics_metrics.name: Infinite-sum/Fourier expression formatting (p.169)
rubrics_metrics.description: (p.169) "k=1 ake(cid:48) k" should read "g = (cid:80)∞ k=1 ake(cid:48) k."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fix the displayed infinite-series / formatting on p.169 so the sum is clearly written as g = sum_{k=1}^∞ a_k e^{... k} (the erratum gives the exact replacement as printed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fourier coefficient factor (p.171)
rubrics_metrics.description: At the bottom of the page, one should read einx2πan instead of einxan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert the missing factor 2π in the term as indicated on p.171.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion of completion — corrected paragraph ending (p.170)
rubrics_metrics.description: (p.170) In the discussion of completion, the end of the last paragraph should read: "To see that H is complete, let {F_k}_{k=1}^∞ be a Cauchy sequence in H, with each F_k represented by ..." (full replacement paragraph as printed in errata).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace the garbled/incorrect final paragraph of the completion discussion on p.170 with the corrected paragraph provided in the errata (the errata gives the explicit corrected text).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of compact set (p.188)
rubrics_metrics.description: The definition of a compact set should read: "a set X ⊂ H is compact if for every sequence {f_n} in X, there exists a subsequence {f_{n_k}} that converges in the norm to an element in X".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies that the sequence {f_n} need not be bounded — replace the incorrect/ambiguous definition on p.188 with this wording.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exercise 3 factor (p.194)
rubrics_metrics.description: (p.194 - Exercise 3) Re(f, g) should be 2 Re(f, g).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiply the displayed/printed Re(f,g) by 2 in Exercise 3 on p.194 to correct the numerical factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference correction (p.301)
rubrics_metrics.description: (p.301) At the bottom of the page reference should be made to Theorem 1.3 in Chapter 3 (and not Theorem 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Change the cross-reference on p.301 to point to Theorem 1.3 of Chapter 3.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notation replacement Hm → Am(H) (p.302)
rubrics_metrics.description: (p.302) Hm should be replaced by Am(H), thus reading µ(Eα) ≤ µ(E_{α/2}) ≤ µ({x : 2 sup_m |Am(H)(x)| > α}).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Correct the notation in the displayed inequality on p.302 by replacing Hm with Am(H) as shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convergence statement (p.302)
rubrics_metrics.description: (p.302) One should read "we know by Theorem 5.1 that Am(f) converges".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace the incorrect/missing convergence statement on p.302 with the explicit assertion that Am(f) converges by Theorem 5.1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proof of Corollary 5.6 expression (p.303)
rubrics_metrics.description: (p.303) In the proof of Corollary 5.6, the displayed quantity involving P(·)(f) and X f dµ should be replaced by the corrected expression (erratum gives the replacement; original printed expression is garbled).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the erratum's replacement to the malformed expression in the proof of Corollary 5.6 on p.303; consult the errata text for the exact corrected expression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exercise 1 assumption (p.312)
rubrics_metrics.description: (p.312) In Exercise 1, make the additional assumption that M is closed under finite intersections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add the extra hypothesis to Exercise 1 on p.312 as specified (ensures the exercise's statements/proofs are valid).

rubrics_metrics.name: Problem 7* conclusion correction (p.321)
rubrics_metrics.description: (p.321 - Problem 7*) In the conclusion "E0 ∫ f#(x) dx ≥ 0", the function f# should be replaced by f.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace f# by f in the concluding displayed inequality of Problem 7* on p.321 (corrects a typographical/notation error).
